text: Hm. im still having a disconnect here unfortunately, because again, here is what 'section D' is to me when im looking at hte ui right now (and im not on the model editor stage) [Image #1] i have: Map Paint icon, Select Icon, Place Piece Icon, Move Selection Icon, Rotate Piece Icon, Paint Material Icon, Paint Faces Icon, Open Color Studio Icon, Sample Material Icon, SNAP surface + edge badge, Down Chevron Icon, Ground Level Badge, Up Chevron Icon, WALLS up badge/button, 3D/2D switch; I dont see add chunk or compile or any of that in this section, which is why i am continuing to clarify
resolution: Used the user's screenshot as the visual truth for Section D and corrected the audit distinction: the observed Build-state strip contains Map Paint, Select, Place, Move, Rotate, Paint Material, Paint Faces, Color Studio, Sample Material, Snap, floor controls, Walls, and 3D/2D; it does not visibly contain Add Chunk, Trigger, Spawn, or Compile. Traced the visible controls and found Paint Material, Open Color Studio, and Sample Material are stronger placebo candidates because Section D sends tool commands only through onTool, while the viewport maps those IDs back to Select and their real runCommand handlers never fire from the bar. No code changed.
